parsed.why: No criminalisation or traveller-facing restriction; progressive Constitutional Court rulings, but documented social hostility, police assembly failure and repeated anti-LGBT bills. Resident LGR gap not counted; exposure is societal friction, not state enforcement.

Dec 2024 penal code criminalises conduct by birth sex with 2-5 years, vague promotion ban, no anti-discrimination recourse, and documented current pattern of arbitrary arrests and abuse targeting gender expression under junta rule.

Life imprisonment for same-sex acts, documented police torture and forced anal examinations, state witch-hunt committee, website blocking, 2024 abduction of trans activist; harsher penalties and state apparatus than dossiers 2 and 5.

Decriminalised since 2016, diplomatic SOGI support, detention non-discrimination rules; no documented traveller-facing exposure or hostility, though data is thin and no trans-specific protections or acceptance are documented.

De-facto criminalisation of gender nonconformity and transition itself under morality offences, no recognition or protections, religious rulings barring care; militia killings and torture are dated and territorial, softening the current picture.
